summary: product returns the cartesian product of lists, equivalent to nested loops, via itertools.product.
questions: How do I do nested loops over two lists in Ansible?
How do I get every combination of items from two lists?

answer_card.title: product filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ listA | product(listB) }}` combines lists into their cartesian product, equivalent to nested loops over both. It passes through to Python's `itertools.product`.
